decisions.source_evidence: The whole word אֱלֹהֵינוּ is visible, with hataf-segol under א and holam on ל. Under ה, a short vertical stroke stands right next to the two tsere dots. It is a separate stroke, not part of the vowel.
The whole word בְּתִפְאֶרֶת is visible. A clear short vertical stroke sits between the segol triad under א and the segol triad under ר, on the meteg side of א's segol.

The whole word עֻזֶּךָ is visible: ע with its slanted three-dot qubuts, ז, and final ך with qamats inside. A short vertical stroke stands beside the segol triad under ז. It is separate from both the ך descender and the qubuts dots.
The whole word בִשְׁמֶךָ. is visible: hiriq under ב and shva under שׁ. A short vertical stroke sits right next to the segol triad under מ, and it is shorter than the ך descender.
The whole word יִתֵּנוּ. is visible, ending in its period. Under ת there are two tsere dots with a separate short vertical stroke right beside them. The stroke drops a little below the dots.
The whole word מַלְכוּתֶךָ. is visible. Short vertical stroke(s) stand right next to the segol triad under ת. At least one of them is clearly separate from the long descender of final ך.

The whole word הַרְנִינוּ is visible, with a patah bar under ה. Next to the first נ there is a dot with a lower, longer vertical stroke beside it. The stroke is about three times as tall as a dot and is set off sideways from it, so it is not the second dot of a shva. One caveat: the shva under ר does not show as a separate mark in this crop.
The whole word עוּזֵּנוּ is visible. A separate short vertical stroke stands right beside the two tsere dots under ז.
The whole word בַחֹדֶשׁ is visible, with holam above ח. Below the letters, a short vertical stroke under ח sits between the patah under ב and the segol triad under ד.

The whole word בַּכֶּסֶה is visible. A short vertical stroke stands between the two segol dot clusters, on the meteg side of כ's segol. The image is a bit blurry, but the stroke is clearly a line and not a dot.
The whole word חַגֵּנוּ: is visible, with a patah under ח. A short vertical stroke stands right beside the two tsere dots under ג and reaches below them.

The whole compound לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי is visible. The vowels are clearly told apart: a T-shaped qamats under י, a flat patah bar under ד, two shva dots under ע, and a hiriq under ת. There is also a separate short vertical stroke next to the patah. Because it has no crossbar, it is not the qamats stem.
The whole word מִסֵּבֶל is visible, with a hiriq under מ. A short vertical stroke sits between the two tsere dots under ס and the segol triad under ב, on the meteg side of ס's tsere.

The whole word אַכְנִיעַ is visible: patah under א, two shva dots under כ, hiriq under נ, and furtive patah under ע. A separate short vertical stroke stands next to the hiriq under נ. It is longer than a dot and does not belong to the shva.
